label: realis-mi
comment: Described as 'proximate tense' in Moser & Marlett (2010); it is not evidential
POS: and often indicates that the event has already occurred or is presently occurring. It cannot be negated
canonical_order: presumably because of the phonological coincidence of the mood prefix and the negative prefix

label: realis-yo
comment: Described as 'proximate tense' in Moser & Marlett (2010)
POS: it is not strictly speaking a past tense
canonical_order: but is probably an evidential (speaker can vouch for it).

label: emphatic realis
comment: Indicates greater amount of emotion and personal involvement on the part of the speaker.

label: dependent irrealis
comment: Irrealis mood used in dependent clauses (not main clauses).

label: independent irrealis
comment: Irrealis mood used in independent (main) clauses.

label: passive
comment: contrasts implicitly with active only for transitive verbs
